items.title: The Clippers will forfeit five first-round draft picks, stretching from 2029-2033.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
The Clippers will forfeit five first-round draft picks, stretching from 2029-2033.

That’s a significant blow to a team that could be sending the Celtics a very valuable first-round pick in 2028 — if they haven’t traded it by then.

LAC just lost considerable flexibility.

Clippers president of business operations Gillian Zucker suspended a year.
